name: happy-path-core-actions
description: One flowing script exercises launchApp, tap, type (into and focused), waitFor, assertVisible, assertNotVisible, swipe, pressKey, back, sleep, and two screenshots, all succeeding
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: happy path
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- tap: Login
- type:
    into: Email
    text: "user@test.com"
- type: "hi"
- waitFor:
    text: Login
    timeout: 0
- assertVisible: Login
- assertNotVisible: Missing
- swipe: up
- pressKey: enter
- back
- sleep: 10
- screenshot: first
- screenshot: second
